decisions.reason: The ERP interface plugin took the largest development investment and is central to the announced multichannel integration direction, so management will treat its missing website mentions as a matter of marketing focus rather than failure.

As the lead price comparison tracking plugin it fits the measurable-marketing positioning the firm has publicly committed to, so management will keep defending it despite its low visibility since 2019.

It overlaps with the other tracking plugins and has not been visible for two years, but sunk development cost and low maintenance cost lead management to keep it in the extension portfolio a while longer.

Three overlapping price comparison plugins with no visible traction since 2019 cannot all be justified, so this one is the most likely to be consolidated away and its resources shifted to the core business.

Although its companion Product A was withdrawn, the reporting plugin still supports the analytics focus the firm has announced, so management keeps it and blames its weak visibility on temporary factors.
